title: 衡量低资源语言的研究进展与语言包容性
summary: 该研究分析2020至2025年间1158篇开放获取论文，提出语言包容性框架（LIF），从研究增长、代表性扩展、代表性连续性和分布公平四个维度衡量语言包容性。结果显示论文数量虽增长5.4倍，但增长集中于已有代表性的语言，亚洲语言占比与代表性严重不匹配，撒哈拉以南非洲和东南亚覆盖率最低。
summary_en: Analyzing 1,158 open-access papers from 2020-2025, this study introduces the Linguistic Inclusion Framework (LIF) measuring inclusion across four dimensions: research growth, representation expansion, representation continuity, and distributional equity. Despite a 5.4X increase in publications, growth concentrated on already-represented languages; Asian languages hold 64.1% of speakers but only 46.7% of representation share, while European languages receive 5.3X their proportional share.
